sloka: तैरवश्यं विधातव्यं व्यलीकं किंचिदेव नः ।तदेव नात्र सन्देहः प्रसह्य परिगृह्यताम् ।। ५.४६.८।।।।
transliteration: tairavaśyaṁ vidhātavyaṁ vyalīkaṁ kiṁcideva naḥ ।tadeva nātra sandehaḥ prasahya parigṛhyatām ।। 5.46.8।।।।

translations.english: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.
